exam_rules: Open-book, not proctored. Taken directly on scrum.org. One browser tab only recommended. No time banking — timer runs continuously. No formal expiry on certifications.
id_requirements: No ID required for online assessments. Email address and scrum.org account required.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-19: Scrum.org's Scaled Professional Scrum certification page is live: 'The Scaled Professional Scrum™ (SPS) certification validates your knowledge of using the Nexus Framework as described in the Nexus Guide.' with 'Certification Details $250 USD per attempt Passing score: 85% Time limit: 60 minutes Number of Questions: 40' and Buy Now.
